title: Reverse Mortgages Explained: The Real Pros and Hidden Cons
bigPicture: A reverse mortgage lets you turn part of your home’s value into cash while you keep living there.
whatYouNeedToKnow: You must be at least 62 years old and own most of your home outright.
You do not have to make monthly payments; the loan is repaid when you sell, move out, or pass away.
Interest and fees add up over time, so the amount you owe can grow.
commonMistakesToAvoid: Not comparing costs and offers from different lenders.
Forgetting that you still need to pay property taxes, insurance, and maintenance.
actionSteps: Speak with a HUD‑approved counselor before you apply.
Get written quotes from at least two lenders and review them with a trusted family member or advisor.
